entities.name: Princess Elizabeth of the United Kingdom
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Princess Elizabeth, called Eliza, was the seventh child and third daughter of King George III and Queen Charlotte. After marrying the Landgrave of Hesse-Homburg, Frederick VI, she took permanent residence in Germany as landgravine.
